test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters which when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the letter series.

Z X _ V _ Z _ C _ B _ X _ V B _ X C _ B

options.text: C, B, X, V, Z, C, Z, V
C, B, Y, W, Z, C, Z, V
C, B, X, W, Z, C, Z, V
C, B, Y, V, Z, C, Z, V

solution:
Given : Z X _ V _ Z _ C _ B _ X _ V B _ X C _ B

Lets check each option :

1) C, B, X, V, Z, C, Z, V → ZX__**C**__V__**B**__ - Z__**X**__C__**V**__B - __**Z**__X__**C**__VB - __**Z**__XC__**V**__B

Here,** ZXCVB is repeating itself**.

2) C, B, Y, W, Z, C, Z, V → ZX__**C**__V__**B**__ - Z__**Y**__C__**W**__B - __**Z**__X__**C**__VB - __**Z**__XC__**V**__B 

No pattern is followed.

3) C, B, X, W, Z, C, Z, V → ZX__**C**__V__**B**__ - Z__**X**__C__**W**__B -** Z**X__**C**__VB -__** Z**__XC__**V**__B

No pattern is followed.

4) C, B, Y, V, Z, C, Z, V → ZX__**C**__V__**B**__ - Z__**Y**__C__**V**__B -__** Z**__X__**C**__VB - __**Z**__XC__**V**__B

No pattern is followed.

Hence, **'option 1'** is the correct answer.
